reranker_instruction: Determine whether Record A and Record B describe the same specific product variant. Shared brand, product family, or similar wording alone is insufficient. Explicit conflicts in model identity, color, size, capacity, flavor, pack quantity, or bundle contents indicate different variants when they describe the offered products. Equivalent translations, abbreviations, and units are not conflicts. Missing attributes alone are not conflicts. An accessory is different from the main product it is compatible with. Answer yes only when the records support the same specific variant without an explicit identity conflict; otherwise answer no.
